text: Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II (BSRP II) is a regional program funded by the European Union and implemented by the Pacific Community (SPC) to reduce disaster and climate risk impacts across 15 Pacific Island Countries, including Papua New Guinea. The initiative focuses on strengthening multi-hazard early warning systems and operational coordination, with a country-led approach anchored in the National Disaster Management Office (NDMO).
